name: Agnikumar Ras

sections.introduction: Agnikumar Ras is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from a mixture of effective herbs. This formulation is known to treat the problems related with digestion and gastrointestinal tract.
sections.ingredients:
Rasendra – Purified and processed Mercury 
 Visha – Purified Aconitum ferox 

 Kaparda Bhasma – Bhasma of Cowries 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 

 Gandhaka – Purified and processed Sulphur 
 Shankha Bhasma – Conch shell Bhasma 
 Tankana – Purified and processed Borax 

 Method of Preparation 

 First of all, take all the ingredients in appropriate quantities. Gandhaka and tankana up to 1 gram, kaparda, visha and shankha bhsama up to 3 grams and maricha up to 8 grams. 
 Now ground mercury and Sulphur together, to prepare a black mass. 
 After preparing this, all other ingredients (in powdered form) are added to black mass and grounded with lemon juice. 
 Now take 125 mg of this paste and make pills from it.
sections.dose: One tablet, one to two times a day, before or after meals.
sections.indications:
Diarrhea 
 Sprue syndrome 
 Indigestion 
 Vomiting (due to indigestion) 
 Abdominal pain 
 Dyspepsia 
 Nausea 
 Dysentery 
 Gastroenteritis 
 Phlegm in excessive
sections.contraindications:
Avoid in pregnancy and lactation 
 Tremors and dizziness due to overdose 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Agnikumar Ras 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Agnimandya 10. 
 Introduction 
 Agnikumar Ras is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from a mixture of effective herbs. This formulation is known to treat the problems related with digestion and gastrointestinal tract. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Rasendra – Purified and processed Mercury 
 Visha – Purified Aconitum ferox 
 
 Kaparda Bhasma – Bhasma of Cowries 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 
 Gandhaka – Purified and processed Sulphur 
 Shankha Bhasma – Conch shell Bhasma 
 Tankana – Purified and processed Borax 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 First of all, take all the ingredients in appropriate quantities. Gandhaka and tankana up to 1 gram, kaparda, visha and shankha bhsama up to 3 grams and maricha up to 8 grams. 
 Now ground mercury and Sulphur together, to prepare a black mass. 
 After preparing this, all other ingredients (in powdered form) are added to black mass and grounded with lemon juice. 
 Now take 125 mg of this paste and make pills from it. 
 
 Dose 
 One tablet, one to two times a day, before or after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Diarrhea 
 Sprue syndrome 
 Indigestion 
 Vomiting (due to indigestion) 
 Abdominal pain 
 Dyspepsia 
 Nausea 
 Dysentery 
 Gastroenteritis 
 Phlegm in excessive 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Avoid in pregnancy and lactation 
 Tremors and dizziness due to overdose 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
